english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately breathing air in.
Use this for the physical act of drawing air into the lungs.

examples.english: After running, I inhale first—don't rush to talk.
examples.traditional: 我跑完步先吸氣，唔好咁急住講嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 sin1 kap1 hei3 m4 hou2 gam3 gap1 zyu6 gong2 je5

examples.english: Before the scan, please inspire slowly through your nose.
examples.traditional: 做檢查之前，請用鼻慢慢吸氣。
examples.jyutping: zou6 gim2 caa4 zi1 cin4 ceng2 jung6 bei6 maan6 maan6 kap1 hei3
